title: [Quality Management] Keep Sample Size and Pass/Fail Quantity within Quantity (Base)
summary: Quality Management inspections now enforce that Sample Size and Pass/Fail Quantity cannot exceed Quantity (Base), preventing data inconsistencies when Quantity (Base) is reduced after inspection creation or when it is zero.
key_points: Sample Size and template Sample Fixed Amount now have MinValue = 0; a negative fixed amount already on a template is treated as 0 so posting is not blocked
Validating Quantity (Base) re-caps a Sample Size that exceeds it
On Finish the applied quantity is Sample Size if above 0, otherwise Quantity (Base), always capped at Quantity (Base), with no silent early exit
Inspections with Quantity (Base) = 0 now finish with Pass/Fail 0 instead of the sample size
Pass/Fail Quantity tooltips state the cap; existing negative Sample Size values are not migrated
